screening_decisions.reason: Not an RCT; this is a descriptive paper on FIGO staging classification for endometrial cancer with no comparison of chemotherapy interventions.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (doxorubicin alone vs doxorubicin+cyclophosphamide) in patients with advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma.
Phase III RCT comparing two chemotherapy regimens (doxorubicin+cisplatin vs doxorubicin+paclitaxel+filgrastim) in advanced endometrial cancer.
Methodology/consensus paper on standardizing reporting of cancer treatment results; not a clinical trial of chemotherapy in endometrial cancer.
Retrospective review of surgical records for pelvic exenteration; not an RCT and does not evaluate chemotherapy.
RCT comparing two chemotherapy agents (adriamycin vs cyclophosphamide) in patients with advanced endometrial cancer.
Randomized phase II trial comparing cisplatin alone vs CAP combination chemotherapy in progestin-refractory advanced endometrial carcinoma.
Randomised phase II trial comparing cyclophosphamide vs ifosfamide in advanced/recurrent endometrial adenocarcinoma.
Systematic overview of beta-blocker trials in myocardial infarction; wrong disease population and not related to endometrial cancer chemotherapy.
RCT comparing two multidrug chemotherapy regimens (melphalan+5-FU+megace vs adriamycin+5-FU+cyclophosphamide+megace) in advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer.
Methodological paper on extracting statistics for meta-analyses; not a clinical trial.
Phase III RCT comparing MVAC vs AC chemotherapy regimens in advanced/recurrent/metastatic endometrial carcinoma.
Phase III RCT comparing doxorubicin+cisplatin with vs without paclitaxel+filgrastim in advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma.
RCT evaluating chemotherapy in non-small cell lung cancer; wrong cancer type.
Abstract describes treatment allocation based on regimen suitability and patient suitability for doxorubicin, with no mention of randomization; therefore not an RCT.
Methodological guidance paper on meta-analysis of time-to-event data; not a clinical trial.
Review/editorial with no trial data presented; not an RCT of chemotherapy.
Systematic review of adjuvant chemotherapy after hysterectomy; adjuvant treatment trials are explicitly excluded by the selection criteria.
Systematic review of hormonal therapy (not cytotoxic chemotherapy) in advanced/recurrent endometrial cancer; intervention does not match review scope.
Review article discussing surgical management and pelvic lymphadenectomy; not an RCT comparing chemotherapy regimens.
Retrospective cohort study describing patterns of treatment failure and survival; not an RCT.
Randomized phase III trial comparing standard timed vs circadian timed administration of doxorubicin+cisplatin in stage III, IV, or recurrent endometrial carcinoma.
Phase III RCT comparing doxorubicin alone vs doxorubicin+cisplatin in advanced (stage III, IV, or recurrent) endometrial carcinoma.
Randomised trial comparing doxorubicin monotherapy vs doxorubicin+cisplatin combination in advanced and/or recurrent endometrial adenocarcinoma.
